title: Leaver: disable the account on Friday and forward the mail

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

input.subject: Leaver - Joe Whitmore, last day Friday

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
Joe Whitmore's last day is Friday 25th. Please disable his account at 5pm and
forward his email to me for three months so I can pick up anything outstanding.

His laptop is coming back to me on the day.

Mel

handling.escalation_reason: Disabling an account removes access, and redirecting someone's mail is a decision with its own rules.

rationale: The ordinary, correct, approved offboarding, requested by the HR manager whose job it is, on a date in the future - and destructive all the same (G4). The mail forward is the part people forget: redirecting a former employee's correspondence to their manager is a data decision, not a mailbox setting. Planned work with a date and nobody blocked, so P3 (G1). Case-040 is the same act requested by a VIP in a hurry; this one is what it looks like when everything is done properly.
